versions.content: If SecOCQueryFreshnessValue = CFUNC AND SecOCUseAuthData Freshness = TRUE for a PDU configuration and the secured PDU is received completely, the SecOC calls the interface function SecOC_GetRxFreshnessAuthData to query the current freshness. A part of the received PDU data are passed to this function as configur ed by the configuration SecOCAuthDataFreshnessStartPosition and SecOCAuthDataFreshnessLen .
